headlines.title: Abdul El-Sayed catches president’s attention with pitch for ‘Trumpcare’
headlines.description: President Donald Trump responded on Saturday to Sen.-elect Abdul El-Sayed’s push for universal healthcare after the progressive Michigan Democrat pitched that it be called “Trumpcare.”

headlines.title: Deadly raid captures top cartel boss in Mexico
headlines.description: A burst of violence erupted in Mexico’s Sinaloa state after authorities say they captured a top cartel leader, known as “El Chapo Isidro.” NBC News’ Dana Griffin reports.

headlines.title: Russia escalates attacks on Ukraine as concerns grow in Europe
headlines.description: Following President Trump’s high-stakes meeting with Russian President Vladimir Putin, there are growing concerns for the future of Ukraine and also Europe. Poland’s leader says a Russian missile that hit Polish territory was likely “intentional.” NBC News’ Keir Simmons reports.

headlines.title: 2026 Rockefeller Center Christmas Tree Arrives in New York City
headlines.description: A magnificent Norway spruce has made its journey from West Edmeston, New York, to Rockefeller Center. The tree will undergo a glow-up ahead of the lighting ceremony on Dec. 2.
